verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents its own headless control surface. It offers a token-authenticated REST API with create, update and delete monitor endpoints and copyable curl examples, plus a global API token for "managing anything" and a Terraform integration, so it can be driven non-interactively from scripts or pipelines. However, nothing shows a first-party CLI or CI-specific usage, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. missing for 10: official CLI, documented CI/CD pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions), machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Automate your workflows and integrate Better Stack with your existing tools using our APIs and protocols.
A global API token is a token valid across all your teams, for managing anything within Better Stack.
Simply include an `Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN` header in your requests.
Create monitor POST ... Update monitor PATCH ... Remove monitor DELETE
